Definition: Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jishmael is Ishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites. In Genesis 16:11, shalt call his name Ishmael. The fuller story is told on the Ishmael profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ishmael belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
